summary: GTJ REIT filed an 8-K solely to report that its operating partnership extended the maturity of its $40 million revolving credit facility and $20 million term loan from August 5, 2026 to August 5, 2027. A 20 basis point extension fee was paid on the revolver commitment and term loan outstanding. This is routine debt management, not a special situation such as restructuring or capital returns. No strategic implications, board actions, or unusual terms are present. Watch for any future amendments or liquidity disclosures, but the filing itself is ordinary course.
